result_preview.title: Product Safety Compliance Change Management API
result_preview.shortDescription: Manages product safety changes and compliance requirements across manufacturing items.
result_preview.description: Provides access to engineering change notifications and product item safety compliance data for manufacturing environments. Exposes safety-related modifications to product specifications and enables retrieval of compliance requirements tied to engineering changes. Manages the integration of product safety assessments with engineering change workflows to ensure regulatory adherence throughout the product lifecycle.

result_preview.title: Quality Assurance and Defect Prevention Agent
result_preview.shortDescription: Monitors production quality, automates defect detection, and coordinates corrective actions across machines and orders.
result_preview.description: Continuously monitors machines and production orders to identify quality anomalies and coordinates real-time defect detection across the production floor. Automates quality inspection workflows by analyzing measurement data, triggering automated holds on non-conforming batches, and initiating corrective actions to prevent downstream quality issues. Processes quality inspection records to optimize production parameters and reduces scrap by coordinating machine recalibration and material rework decisions.

result_preview.title: Dangerous Goods Supply Chain Safety Agent
result_preview.shortDescription: Tracks hazardous material declarations from vendors and triggers response protocols for safety events.
result_preview.description: Automates oversight of hazardous material certifications within the supplier ecosystem and ingests real-time safety event notifications. Executes regulatory verification processes, identifies non-compliance signals, and routes urgent safety alerts to procurement teams for corrective intervention and risk mitigation across the supply chain.

result_preview.title: Compliance Campaign Orchestrator
result_preview.shortDescription: Automates safety compliance campaigns across customer segments and accounts.
result_preview.description: Coordinates regulatory compliance initiatives by monitoring campaign effectiveness across customer segments and accounts. Automates safety inspection scheduling, processes compliance status updates, and manages escalation workflows for identified safety gaps. Orchestrates targeted safety interventions based on customer account risk profiles and segment-level compliance trends.

result_preview.title: Safety Inspection Campaign Management API
result_preview.shortDescription: Manages and retrieves safety inspection campaigns linked to customer accounts.
result_preview.description: Exposes safety inspection campaign data and customer account relationships to coordinate scheduled inspections, track compliance status across customer sites, and provide access to inspection results and remediation tracking. Enables seamless integration of inspection workflows with customer account management systems for comprehensive EHS oversight.
